title: How to Build an Invoice Generator App (No Coding Required)
summary: Build a custom invoice generator with PDF export, client management, and payment tracking in an afternoon. Everything included — no Supabase, no Vercel. Step-by-step guide.
body_markdown: Under two hours from first prompt to deployed app. The database, auth, and invoice form are generated from your description. The remaining time goes to connecting Stripe and customizing the PDF layout. A developer building the same feature set from scratch typically needs 6–12 hours.
